verdict.rationale: PII detection and filtering is a fair question for a web-data extraction platform like Browserbase, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents automatic detection or redaction of personally identifiable information in scraped content. Features such as network interception, URL-to-markdown fetching and file processing are adjacent building blocks, not a PII-filtering capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically detect and filter personally identifiable information out of scraped content before it reaches storage
